description: Reviewed CI ratchet deltas for intentional functionality added before the architecture snapshots were refreshed. Every allowance is exact so unrelated growth or routes still fail. The route-manifest additions were folded into config/route-manifest.json on 2026-08-05 and again when the earlier Golden Coast phases reached main, so those lists only contain exact reviewed deltas since that snapshot: the three Phase 7 sales-cash-transfer middleware mounts introduced by the Phase 16 HADI transfer guard. config/source-text-assertion-baseline.json was regenerated once audit-source-text-assertions learned to see relative-URL source reads, so every test previously carried here as a reviewed delta now lives in that baseline, which is the canonical list. The one remaining source-text allowance is #1193's added expect(routeSource).toContain("new Decimal(shared.debit).minus(shared.credit).abs()") in server/routes/sp/spGoldenCoastPhase11MonthlyCloseRoutes.test.ts, a test the regenerated baseline already records: the assertion arrived on main after the baseline was taken, and it is the first one this ratchet has caught that the old repo-rooted-path detector would have missed entirely.
